versions.author: StreamCurves regional analysis (STAF)
versions.revisionNotes: Reference condition is the fixed landscape-pressure screen least-disturbed-v1 (strict), wadeable non-canal frame. 25 of 159 stations of this ecoregion pass. 17 reference curves use local stations, 5 borrow from a wider region, 5 metrics use fixed criteria, and 2 metrics are withheld for insufficient reference support.
